papers.title_en: FGD2HF: Frequency-guided Dual-domain Hypergraph Fusion for Semantic Segmentation
papers.authors: Xiaofan Yang, Wei Pan, Yubin Liu, Junyu Wu, Junming Zhang, Jie Zhao
papers.evidence: 频域引导的双域语义分割网络
papers.tldr: 现有基于频域的语义分割方法存在频率利用不充分、融合效率低、计算复杂度高的问题。为此提出FGD2HF双域融合网络：用邻域注意力与超图注意力构建混合注意力编码器，并以小波变换增强模块提取高低频线索，引导空间特征的分组与传播。在ADE20K上达48.7% mIoU，Cityscapes上达83.2%，均以更少GFLOPs取得有竞争力的结果。该方法以低计算成本实现频域引导的双域融合，并显著提升边界分割精度。
papers.abstract_en: Frequency-domain information is beneficial for semantic segmentation. However, existing frequency-based methods often suffer from insufficient frequency utilization, inefficient fusion, and high computational complexity. To address these issues, we propose FGD2HF, a dual-domain fusion network that leverages frequency features to guide spatial-domain fusion and enhancement. Specifically, we introduce a novel Hybrid-Attention Encoder (NAHA) that jointly models local and global relationships through neighborhood and hypergraph attention, enhancing the network's ability to extract effective features. We further introduce a Wavelet Transform and Enhancement (WTE) module to extract and refine low- and high-frequency cues from preceding-stage features, followed by Frequency-guided Dual-domain Fusion (FGDF) modules that use frequency cues to condition current-stage spatial grouping and feature propagation. This design incorporates both global and local frequency guidance into spatial feature modulation, enhancement and fusion with low computational cost. Extensive comparisons with numerous state-of-the-art semantic segmentation methods demonstrate that our method is highly competitive. Our full FGD2HF-B model achieves 48.7% mIoU on ADE20K (+0.3% over SegMAN-B with 18% fewer GFLOPs), 83.2% mIoU on Cityscapes (comparable to SegMAN-B with 21% fewer GFLOPs), and 1.1% higher mIoU than VWFormer-T on SBD with 21% fewer GFLOPs, while also achieving significant improvements in boundary segmentation accuracy.

papers.title_en: GeoPrompt: Geometry-Conditioned Prompt Learning for Underwater Open-Vocabulary Instance Segmentation
papers.authors: Shanshan Han, Yuxi Wang, Can Qin, Yujie Chen, Cong Pan, Haitao Li, Guoqiang Zhong
papers.evidence: 面向水下场景的开放词汇实例分割
papers.tldr: 水下开放词汇实例分割依靠视觉-文本对齐识别新旧类别，但颜色衰减、散射、浑浊和低对比度会扭曲外观，使区域特征偏离语义，未见类识别尤其脆弱。GeoPrompt提出几何条件提示学习，核心是利用比外观更稳定的深度几何结构：GVAM提取结构先验并注入多尺度视觉特征，GCPL据此生成几何感知文本分类器，再与固定及图像条件分类器融合以增强对齐。在MARIS-OpenIS基准上取得最优结果，并持续提升水下开放词汇实例分割性能。该工作为退化水下场景提供了几何引导的开放词汇语义对齐新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary instance segmentation (OVIS) provides a promising solution for marine perception by recognizing and segmenting categories beyond predefined label spaces. Existing OVIS methods usually rely on vision-language alignment, where visual region features are matched with textual category embeddings to recognize both seen and unseen classes. However, this alignment assumption becomes fragile in underwater environments. Color attenuation, scattering, turbidity, and low contrast distort visual appearance, causing region features to deviate from their corresponding semantic concepts. As a result, the similarity between degraded visual features and textual classifiers becomes unreliable, which particularly weakens the recognition of unseen underwater categories that cannot be corrected by category-specific supervision. To address these issues, we propose GeoPrompt, a geometry-conditioned prompt learning framework for underwater open-vocabulary instance segmentation. Our key insight is that geometric structure is more stable than visual appearance in degraded underwater scenes. Specifically, GeoPrompt introduces a geometry-guided visual adaptation module (GVAM) to extract depth-derived structural priors and inject them into multi-scale visual features. It further develops a geometry-conditioned prompt learning (GCPL) that generates geometry-aware textual classifiers from structural representations. These geometry-aware classifiers are integrated with fixed and image-conditioned textual classifiers to improve open-vocabulary semantic alignment. Experiments on the MARIS-OpenIS benchmark show that GeoPrompt achieves state-of-the-art performance and brings consistent improvements on underwater open-vocabulary instance segmentation.

papers.title_en: LingGS: Decoupling Feed-Forward Geometry Prediction from Camera Tracking for High-Fidelity Gaussian SLAM
papers.authors: Da Li, Yihan Zang, Ivan Viola, Zeyu Wang, Dominik Engel
papers.evidence: 冻结的流式三维基础模型提供单目视频深度估计
papers.tldr: 针对单目RGB Gaussian SLAM在有限优化预算下重建与跟踪难以兼顾的问题，LingGS将前馈几何预测与相机跟踪解耦。方法用冻结的流式3D基础模型提供单目深度，作为虚拟RGB-D传感器，再由显式几何求解器通过特征重投影估计相机运动，并用流式Gaussian建图器融合观测。实验在室内外数据集上提升重建质量，单张RTX 4090约7 FPS，吞吐量为对比SLAM系统的2-3倍。该工作表明显式几何跟踪优于学习式相机预测，并可跨流式几何骨干泛化。
papers.abstract_en: Achieving high-quality reconstruction and responsive camera tracking remains challenging for monocular RGB Gaussian splatting SLAM under a limited optimization budget. We present an online system that addresses this challenge by combining learned geometric priors with explicit geometric camera tracking, which can substantially outperform learned camera prediction in terms of tracking accuracy. A frozen streaming 3D foundation model serves as a virtual RGB-D sensor, providing depth estimation from monocular video. An explicit geometric solver then estimates camera motion through feature reprojection, and a streaming Gaussian mapper integrates the resulting observations into a dense scene representation. We further show that geometric tracking improves camera pose accuracy across representative streaming geometry backbones, demonstrating the broader applicability of our approach. Extensive experiments on indoor and outdoor datasets show that our method significantly improves reconstruction quality over existing approaches, achieving about 7 FPS on a single RTX 4090 and delivering 2-3 times the throughput of the evaluated prior SLAM systems.
